data.title: Senate struggles to pass Clarity Act as key vote on Crypto Bill fails to go through, causing delays.
data.description: A recent report revealed that the global revenue from the video game industry reached a record-breaking $159.3 billion in 2020. This represents a 9.3% increase from the previous year. Mobile gaming accounted for the largest share of the revenue, generating $73.8 billion, while console gaming revenue totaled $51.2 billion and PC gaming revenue amounted to $39.5 billion. The growth in gaming revenue was attributed to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, which led to increased usage and engagement with video games worldwide. The report also highlighted that the Asia-Pacific region was the largest gaming market, accounting for $78.3 billion in revenue. These numbers emphasize the significant growth and impact of the video game industry on a global scale.

data.title: AMAZON TEAMSTERS RALLY IN SUPPORT OF CHICAGO DELIVERY PROTECTION ACT
data.description: Chicago City Council held a subject matter hearing on a bill that would put an end to delivery subcontracting in the city. On September 15, 2026, Amazon Teamsters and supporters gathered outside City Hall to push for a vote on the Delivery Protection. The bill aims to bring an end to the practice of subcontracting delivery services within Chicago. This development comes as part of efforts to address concerns related to job security and labor practices in the delivery sector. The underlying issue has garnered significant attention, with mounting pressure on the City Council to address the matter promptly. Stay tuned for further updates on this ongoing issue.

data.title: Pulse Radiology Institute and DeVry University Partner to Address Nationwide MRI Technologist Shortage

data.title: In HelloNation, Home Care Expert Dan Pahos Clarifies When Families Should Consider Home Care for Seniors
data.description: Identifying the right time to consider home care for elderly parents who are having difficulty with daily tasks is crucial. In Birmingham, Alabama, on September 15, 2026, experts advised families to assess the situation when a parent is finding it challenging to handle daily activities. This includes basic tasks like meals, medication management, and personal hygiene. It is important to note that approximately 16% of seniors aged 65 and above require some form of long-term care, which often involves home care services. Recognizing these signs early on allows families to plan and ensure the senior receives the appropriate level of care they need.
